title: Aunt Annette’s Holiday Brisket
htmlIngredientLines: Seas Salt and freshly cracked pepper
1 large onion, peeled and finely chopped
4 carrots, trimmed and peeled (1 diced and 3 cut crosswise into 3-inch pieces
2 cloves of garlic peeled and finely chopped
1-1/2 cups of sweet kosher wine Concord grade wine (such as Manischewitz) or 1 -1/2 cups of dry red wine plus 1/4 cup of brown sugar
